title: Olaide Asimiyu Akin-Olagunju
gist: A brief World Bank staff-profile page for consultant Olaide Asimiyu Akin-Olagunju, whose sole listed 2026 post ties him to a July 2026 World Bank piece on Nigerian agricultural resilience produced with FAO/IFAD project involvement.

insights.claim: Akin-Olagunju's sole listed post, 'From loss to resilience in Nigeria: turning a growing agricultural challenge into action' (July 22, 2026), links his prior involvement in the NASC project with the FAO and IFAD to a current World Bank publication on Nigerian agricultural resilience.
insights.speaker: World Bank Blogs
insights.so_what: Identifies a specific FAO/IFAD-linked World Bank Nigeria agriculture data initiative (NASC) worth tracing for related datasets or funding announcements.
insights.locator: including the collaborative NASC project with the FAO and IFAD

insights.claim: His research background combines agricultural policy, household welfare, income inequality and international trade, holding a PhD in Agricultural Economics from the University of Ibadan and having worked on impact evaluation with the Nigeria Gender Innovation Lab.
insights.speaker: World Bank Blogs
insights.so_what: Establishes the technical grounding (agricultural economics + impact evaluation) behind his contribution to World Bank Nigeria agriculture research.
insights.locator: Olaide's research spans agricultural policy, household welfare, income inequalities and international trade.
